data.require_profile_confirmation: Require profile confirmation for each weighing
data.weight_plausibility_check: Check that the weight fits the profile

data_description.user_id: Advanced shared wire-level scale slot for every profile. Leave the default 1 unless you know a different slot is required.
data_description.allow_bind: Enable only when this adapter is not authorized by the scale and binding is needed. Binding can change the existing association; leave off if already authorized.
data_description.require_profile_confirmation: When enabled, a scale wake asks Home Assistant automations to confirm which profile is weighing.
data_description.weight_plausibility_check: Compares each weighing with the profile’s last weighing from the past 30 days. Allowed: 10% when phone proximity or a confirmation chose the profile, 5% otherwise, 10% against the initial weight hint before the first weighing. A mismatch moves the weighing to the only other profile within 5%, without body fat, because the scale calculated it with the wrong profile. Otherwise the weighing is discarded and huawei_ah100_measurement_rejected is emitted.
data_description.proximity_profile_selection: When the scale wakes and exactly one profile phone is near the Bluetooth scanner that sees the scale best, that profile is used. Otherwise the active profile or the confirmation request applies as before.
data_description.proximity_rssi_threshold: Minimum phone signal strength at the scale’s scanner. Use the profile’s Phone signal diagnostic sensor to choose a value; closer is stronger, for example -55 dBm instead of -75 dBm.
